title: Single-Stage Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation with Localization Token and Memory Bank

nodes.label: Input Image
nodes.semantic_desc: Input RGB image; provides raw pixels to the transformer patch embedding for feature extraction.
nodes.visual_desc: A natural scene photograph (e.g., urban street) without any text annotations.

nodes.label: Image-level Labels
nodes.semantic_desc: Weak supervision in the form of image-level class presence labels; used to supervise the classification branch.
nodes.visual_desc: A small tag/list icon with class names (e.g., {car, person, road}) shown as external labels next to the image.

nodes.label: Patch Embedding
nodes.semantic_desc: Converts the input image into a sequence of patch tokens (smaller patches than standard) for transformer processing; outputs patch token sequence.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Patch Embedding (Small Patches)' with a small grid icon indicating fine patching.

nodes.label: Localization Token
nodes.semantic_desc: A dedicated token injected at the input token sequence to strengthen pixel/region localization under weak supervision; outputs augmented token sequence.
nodes.visual_desc: A small highlighted token block labeled 'Loc Token' appended to a token sequence schematic.

nodes.label: SegFormer Backbone
nodes.semantic_desc: Transformer encoder backbone (SegFormer-style); takes augmented tokens and outputs multi-scale feature maps for classification and segmentation decoding.
nodes.visual_desc: A large rounded rectangle labeled 'SegFormer Backbone' with stacked feature pyramid bars (multi-scale) on the right.

nodes.label: Adapter Module
nodes.semantic_desc: Lightweight adaptation blocks integrated with backbone features/tokens to improve weakly supervised pixel learning; outputs adapted feature maps.
nodes.visual_desc: A small plug-in block labeled 'Adapter' attached to a feature-map icon (like a sidecar module).

nodes.label: Classification Head
nodes.semantic_desc: Takes global pooled backbone features and outputs image-level class logits for weak supervision training.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Cls Head' followed by a small vector bar chart icon representing class logits.

nodes.label: Classification Loss
nodes.semantic_desc: Supervises image-level predictions using image-level labels; takes class logits and ground-truth image tags and outputs a scalar loss.
nodes.visual_desc: A hexagon labeled 'L_cls' with a small sigma (Σ) or loss icon.

nodes.label: Segmentation Decoder
nodes.semantic_desc: Takes multi-scale (adapted) backbone features and outputs per-pixel segmentation logits at image resolution.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Decoder' converting pyramid feature icons into a dense map icon.

nodes.label: Predicted Segmentation
nodes.semantic_desc: Model per-pixel semantic predictions (logits/probabilities); used for visualization and for pseudo-label supervised learning.
nodes.visual_desc: A color-coded segmentation mask overlay on the input image (distinct colors for different classes).

nodes.label: Patch Clustering
nodes.semantic_desc: Clusters fine-grained patch features to form consistent region prototypes; outputs cluster assignments and/or region-level representations for pseudo-labeling.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Patch Clustering' with a scatter plot icon grouped into colored clusters.

nodes.label: Memory Bank
nodes.semantic_desc: Stores and updates feature prototypes/cluster centroids across iterations; provides retrieved prototypes to stabilize pseudo-label generation.
nodes.visual_desc: A database cylinder labeled 'Memory Bank' with small feature-vector icons inside.

nodes.label: Pseudo-label Generator
nodes.semantic_desc: Generates pseudo segmentation labels using predicted segmentation and clustered/prototype information; outputs per-pixel pseudo labels (hard/soft).
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Pseudo-label Gen' producing a mask with some regions highlighted as confident.

nodes.label: Pseudo Labels
nodes.semantic_desc: Generated per-pixel supervision targets; used to supervise the predicted segmentation map.
nodes.visual_desc: A segmentation-like mask with only confident regions colored and uncertain regions gray/transparent.

nodes.label: Segmentation CE Loss
nodes.semantic_desc: Cross-entropy loss between predicted segmentation logits and pseudo labels; outputs a scalar segmentation supervision signal.
nodes.visual_desc: A hexagon labeled 'L_ce' with a small cross-entropy/target icon (two distributions).
